prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in until after pet adoption was effective and slightly outperformed predictions (+13.3% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
Home page redesigns like interactive waiting rooms are helpful (+5.6% measured), though initial predictions were too high (+8.0% predicted).
Adoption incentives like photo quality guides and companion previews improved results (+7.6% measured), but were overestimated (+10.0% predicted).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: +7.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +13.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In to Onboarding Hand-off: Reorder the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation finishes, immediately before introducing the pet on the desktop. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing after logging back in; placing sign-in right before desktop delivery reinforces cloud sync.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Save Status & Sync Assurance Badge: Display a prominent cloud save assurance hint and status badge on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again; clear messaging prevents confusion about saved pet data.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live 3D Render Hatching Progress Tracker: Enable live progress percentage bar and detailed status updates during the pet creation wait screen. (why: The waiting step mean time reaches 2336s; explicit progress indicators assure users the desktop app is actively working.)
3: [finish, notification] System Tray Location & Shortcut Notification Tip: Add a reminder hint showing users where the app lives in the desktop taskbar and how to summon the pet. (why: 3 support messages noted pets failing to display on desktop or users unable to re-open the app after setup.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Onboarding Path Selection Copy: Revise the choose_path headline and body copy to clearly differentiate instant starter pets from photo custom creations. (why: choose_path mean duration is 514s despite low median (8s), showing long-tail confusion when selecting an adoption path.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in directly addresses 8 support tickets and matches proven historical lift (+13.3%).
High evidence (8 emails) and config-only change, but sign-in step drop is moderate.
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) at home step, but requires custom UI build.
Targets high finish step drop (35.2%) with minimal config-only tip implementation.
Addresses 514s mean duration confusion on path selection via easy copy tweak.
